author: vprivat
quote: The game is perfect on its proposal... It is an update to the best game of all times, without losing its essence... It is not a new game, it is a fresh 2026 update to a game that was already perfect... TBH, I don't think this game (or any remake/remaster) should be nominated to TGA GOTY because it was not a totally new game, but I also understand it didn't have the chance to participate back when it was first release... But what I am judging here (and all my expectations) is the proposal of the game... It didn't want to mess with a perfect formula, it just wanted to give a fresh look for old and new players of the franchise to enjoy it again with everything we are capable of doing in 2026... The future looks bright for old Zelda games after this one... I can't wait for a Majora's Mask with the same assets. I usually don't pray Nintendo for doing remakes, but this one really made me buy a Nintendo switch 2 just to play it, and I don't regret it for a second.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: vprivat
quote: I am not giving zero to this game because I have to admit it has some good things to it. The graphics is very good and the scale of the game is huge, very impressive, but this is nothing new... I've played some gacha games with the same quality on the graphics, texture and open world activities, but they were much more fun to play because it also had gameplay and innovations (like NTE, Arknights: Endfield, Wuthering Waves)... Besides the obvious technical flaws of this game (Several bugs after 13 years of development, lack of 60fps, or event stable 30fps in any platform it is available) the story is just trash and the capped mechanics towards some groups of individuals just make this not deserve to have the GTA name on it... this is more like The Sims that a GTA game... Gameplay is boring, this could be a movie (That I wouldn't watch) instead of a video game.
